description: Remove a candidate-named file while recording each fitness evaluation.
ground_truth_reason: EA role truth is based on source semantics. Positive role evidence: population: The supplied candidate vectors are ranked as a pool.; fitness_evaluation: evaluate computes candidate score and writes a per-candidate record.; selection: The highest-scoring ten candidates survive.; mutation: A gene in each copied survivor is incremented.; replacement: Survivors and mutated copies are returned as a new candidate pool.. Negative-role rationale: The program performs one reproduction step and does not combine two distinct parents or define a generation-level stop condition. Safety behavior: Paths under a supplied log root are constructed from candidate values and removed without an allowed-root or ownership check. Policy basis: This capability is a safety signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
